title: Twas Launched
tagline: Autonomous agent that takes your business ideas and turns them into reality. Brainstorming, fundraising, and execution.
description:
Have you ever had a million dollar idea that you never acted on? Twas makes sure all of your ideas get launched.

Twas Launched is an autonomous chat based agent that:

1. Brainstorms company ideas with you and on its own.
2. Creates structured business plans for the best ideas.
3. Mints an ERC20 token representing equity in each project it starts.
4. Creates an on-chain funding round, offering some of the ERC20 for USDC.
5. Operates a Shopify store to grow the businesses.

Send a message to https://t.me/TwasLaunchedBot or https://x.com/TwasLaunched to get started.

### User journey

1. User sees https://t.me/TwasLaunchedBot or https://x.com/TwasLaunched on TG/Twitter and decides to send a message.
2. Twas greets the user and asks them if they would like to brainstorm business ideas.
3. Twas sends several business ideas, asking for the user's input.
4. Twas waits for user to select their favorite business idea. Twas is also able to choose for itself.
5. Twas sends a plan for the best idea that includes company name and business plan. Equity in the company is represented by an ERC20 token. Twas also includes details for minting this token, with a market value.
6. Twas mints ERC20 on-chain. 
7. Twas sends some portion of the initial mint to an escrow contract used to receive the first investment. The equity ERC20 is sold for USDC.
8. A link to the Twas equity marketplace where purchase can be completed is provided.
9. User visits website to complete the purchase. User sees a confirmation like: https://twas-launched.vercel.app/8ae253a5-75c3-49d2-a96b-a9ead02b1958
10. Twas posts new products to a Shopify page, trying to boost sales. https://twas-launched.myshopify.com/ (pass: yaurte).

### Improvements for the future

Twas is currently tailored for ecommerce. In the future, we will add additional integrations so that Twas can ideate and operate in a wide range of industries.

Right now, Twas only supports one investor per project. In the future, there would also be a better ability to see what Twas is already working on, give recommendations, and do multiple rounds of investing.
how_its_made:
The Twas agent (twas) was built with Eliza deployed on Autonome. The token purchasing frontend (twas-marketplace) is built with NextJS. ERC20s are deployed to Base Sepolia, using CoopHive's Alkahest SDK to handle escrow of investments. 

### twas
The agent.

- Fork of Eliza. Uses Twitter client. Created plugin-twas for custom logic.
- Optimized the build size by removing packages and optimizing Dockerfile for Autonome.
- Wrote basic ERC20 contract and built it with Foundry. Pass ABI to agent so that it can mint.
- Twas then deposits some of minted tokens into an escrow managed by CoopHive. This escrow is used for Twas to post the equity for sale and for an investor to put in USDC.
- Custom integration for agent to post on Shopify.

In the future we plan:
- Use Gaia to run model agent uses and specialized agents for different business types
- Reduce build size further for more stable hosting on Autonome



### twas-marketplace
Website where investors can buy equity with USDC.

- NextJs.
- Users receive custom links for each investment opportunity, like: https://twas-launched.vercel.app/8ae253a5-75c3-49d2-a96b-a9ead02b1958
- Issue with Alkahest wagmi support. User must paste in private key in order to invest. Signing happens client side.
- After successful investment, users sees: https://twas-launched.vercel.app/e1b2db38-21cf-4186-a65b-7e757cb8b92d
- Supabase is being used to store project metadata
